Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __that is not a cell wall degrading enzyme__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __mature or immature embryos__.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of genotyping and sequencing__. 

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __their analyzed genotype__.
